stem: What happens next in this passage after “They wrote notes about the chair.”?
options: One older student said he understood math better after teaching it.
After they left, the young customer said, "Now I understand.
After the contest, Grace said she still did not like standing on stage.
One said, "I sat here when I cried after a fight."
